blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: In diffusion transformers, a class label or a text prompt is embedded once, and the same condition is reused at every denoising step. We ask whether predicted embeddings can serve as this condition instead. Next-Embedding Predictive Autoregression (NEPA) trains a Transformer to predict the next continuous embedding in a sequence. In generation, the clean image follows the noisy image, so its embeddings are the next embeddings after the condition and the noisy image. We train a NEPA model to predict them all at once with Multi-Embedding Prediction , and in Embedding Conditioned Generation , a DiT generator is conditioned on these predictions, recomputed at every denoising step, so the conditioning signal adapts to the current noisy state. Experiments on class-conditional ImageNet 256 × 256 256\times 256 study the condition of the generator, the design of Multi-Embedding Prediction, and the scaling of both models. The NEPA model adds a second network to every sampling step; with it, and combined with REPA, our final model, NEPA-DiT-XL , reaches an FID of 1.32 using about a third of the training compute of REPA.
blocks.zh: 在扩散变压器中,一个类标签或文本提示被嵌入一次,每个去诺步骤都重复使用同样的条件. 我们问,预测的嵌入是否可以作为这一条件。 Next-Embedding Presidentive Autregression (NEPA) 训练了一台变形器来预测下一个连续嵌入的序列. 在一代中,干净的图像跟随吵闹的图像,因此它的嵌入是条件和吵闹的图像后接下来的嵌入. 我们训练一个 NEPA 模型 来同时预测它们与多 Embedding President, 在 Embedding Contitioned Generation 中, 一个 DiT 生成器 是以这些预测为条件的, 在每个去诺步骤上重算, 所以调节信号适应了当前的噪音状态。 班级条件成像网的实验 256×256\times 256研究了发电机的状况,多Embedding Preview的设计,以及两种模型的缩放. NEPA模式在每一个取样步骤中都增加了第二个网络;与REPA一起,我们的最后模式NEPA-DIT-XL使用REPA培训计算值的大约三分之一达到1.32的FID.

blocks.en: Diffusion transformers have become the standard backbone for image generation ( Peebles & Xie, 2023 ; Ma et al., 2024 ; Esser et al., 2024 ) . Across these models, the condition enters through a fixed interface: a class label or a text prompt is embedded once, and the same condition is reused at every denoising step. It is left to the generator to work out what the condition implies for the image at hand as its state moves from noise to a clean sample. Recent work brings pretrained visual representations into this pipeline, as alignment targets for the generator’s features ( Yu et al., 2025 ) , as the latent space in which diffusion operates ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) , or as intermediate generation targets ( Li et al., 2024a ) .
blocks.zh: 分流变压器已成为图像生成的标准主干(Peebles & Xie, 2023; Ma等, 2024; Esser等, 2024). 在整个这些模型中,条件通过固定接口进入:一个类标签或文本提示被嵌入一次,在每一个去诺步骤中,同样的条件被再用. 当图像的状态从噪音变为清洁样品时,由生成者来研究其条件的含义。 最近的工作将事先经过训练的视觉表现带入这一管道,作为发电机特性的对接目标(Yu等人,2025年),作为进行扩散的潜在空间(Zheng等人,2026年),或作为中间生成目标(Li等人,2024年a年)。

blocks.en: In all of these, the condition itself stays fixed while the image evolves. We ask: can the condition itself be predicted from the current noisy image, at every denoising step?
blocks.zh: 在所有这些中,条件本身在图像进化时保持不变. 我们问:能否从当前吵闹的图像中,在每一个发号施令的步骤中,预测状况本身?

blocks.en: NEPA trains a Transformer to predict the next embedding in a sequence, rather than to reconstruct pixels or discrete tokens ( Xu et al., 2025 ) . Unlike a feature extractor, such a model is predictive by construction: its outputs are estimates of embeddings it has not yet seen. In generation, the sequence runs from the condition through the noisy image to the clean image, so the clean image is what comes next, and its predicted embeddings are a natural candidate for what a generator should condition on.
blocks.zh: NEPA训练出一个变形器,以预测下一个嵌入序列,而不是重建像素或离散的符号(徐等,2025年). 与地物提取器不同的是,这种模型通过构造可以预测:其输出值是对它尚未见到的嵌入物的估计. 在一代中,序列从条件通过吵闹的图像一直到清洁的图像,所以清洁的图像是接下来的,其所预测的嵌入物是生成者应该条件的自然候选.

blocks.en: We answer this question with Embedding Conditioned Generation (ECG): a DiT generator is conditioned on the embeddings predicted by a frozen NEPA model instead of on the raw condition, and the NEPA model is queried at every denoising step, so the conditioning signal adapts to the current noisy state. The NEPA model is trained with Multi-Embedding Prediction (MEP), which extends NEPA to predict the next several embeddings at once, as multi-token prediction does for tokens in language modeling ( Gloeckle et al., 2024 ) ; it reads the condition and the noisy image and predicts the embeddings of the clean image (Figure 1 ).

Combined with REPA, our final model, NEPA-DiT-XL, reaches an FID of 1.32 .

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Diffusion Models and Representations for Generation
blocks.zh: 2.1 世代传播模式和表现

blocks.en: Denoising diffusion models have become a dominant framework for image generation ( Song & Ermon, 2019 ; Ho et al., 2020 ; Song et al., 2021b ; Nichol & Dhariwal, 2021 ; Dhariwal & Nichol, 2021 ) , supported by faster samplers ( Song et al., 2021a ; Lu et al., 2022 ; Song et al., 2023 ) and by flow-based formulations ( Lipman et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2023 ; Ma et al., 2024 ; Huang et al., 2026 ) . Latent diffusion models operate in the latent space of a pretrained autoencoder to reduce the computational cost ( Rombach et al., 2022 ; Esser et al., 2021 ; Chen et al., 2025b ; Yao et al., 2025 ) , while diffusion transformers replace U-Net denoisers with more scalable architectures ( Peebles & Xie, 2023 ; Bao et al., 2023 ) . Text-to-image models further improve these systems through stronger architectures, flow-based objectives, and text conditioning ( Nichol et al., 2022 ; Ramesh et al., 2022 ; Saharia et al., 2022 ; Balaji et al., 2023 ; Podell et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2024b ; Chen et al., 2024a ; Esser et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2024c ; Peng et al., 2025 ; Xie et al., 2025 ; Xie et al., 2026 ) . Beyond synthesis, diffusion models have been adapted to text-guided image manipulation and editing ( Meng et al., 2022 ; Hertz et al., 2023 ; Mokady et al., 2023 ; Brooks et al., 2023 ; Xu et al., 2023 ; Xu et al., 2024 ) , to spatially controlled generation ( Zhang et al., 2023 ) , and to temporally consistent video generation ( Ho et al., 2022 ; Guo et al., 2024 ; Xia et al., 2024 ) . Pretrained visual representations have been brought into this pipeline as generation targets ( Li et al., 2024a ; Wu et al., 2025 ; Kouzelis et al., 2025b ) , alignment signals for diffusion features ( Yu et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026b ; Jiang et al., 2026 ; Tian et al., 2026 ; Leng et al., 2025 ) , and the generative latent space ( Zheng et al., 2026 ; Tong et al., 2026 ; Singh et al., 2026 ) . In these models, the class or text condition is injected by adaLN ( Peebles & Xie, 2023 ) or joint attention ( Esser et al., 2024 ) and stays fixed across denoising steps. Unified multimodal models condition a diffusion decoder on embeddings produced by a language model ( Sun et al., 2024b ; Ge et al., 2024 ; Pan et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025a ) , but these embeddings are likewise computed once before sampling. Self-conditioning ( Chen et al., 2023 ) feeds the estimate of the clean sample from the previous sampling step back into the denoiser, and RIN ( Jabri et al., 2023 ) carries latent states across steps; both reuse the estimates of the denoiser itself. We condition the generator on the predictions of a separate NEPA model, trained with its own embedding prediction objective and recomputed from the current noisy input at every step.

blocks.en: 2.2 Predictive Representation Learning
blocks.zh: 2.2 预测性代表性学习

blocks.en: Self-supervised visual learning has progressed from handcrafted pretext tasks ( Doersch et al., 2015 ; Noroozi & Favaro, 2016 ; Zhang et al., 2016 ; Gidaris et al., 2018 ) to contrastive and self-distillation methods ( van den Oord et al., 2019 ; He et al., 2020 ; Chen et al., 2020 ; Grill et al., 2020 ; Caron et al., 2020 ; Caron et al., 2021 ; Zhou et al., 2022 ) and to masked reconstruction approaches that predict pixels, tokens, or visual features ( Bao et al., 2022 ; He et al., 2022 ; Xie et al., 2022 ; Wei et al., 2022 ; Baevski et al., 2022 ) . Generative image models instead learn by predicting discrete or continuous visual tokens, either autoregressively or through masked and progressively refined prediction ( van den Oord et al., 2017 ; Esser et al., 2021 ; Yu et al., 2022 ; Lee et al., 2022 ; Chang et al., 2022 ; Li et al., 2023 ; Yu et al., 2024 ; Tian et al., 2024 ; Sun et al., 2024a ; Li et al., 2024b ) . However, pixel and discrete-token prediction can emphasize low-level details or tokenizer-specific structure. Predictive representation learning avoids direct reconstruction by predicting targets in a learned embedding space: JEPA and I-JEPA predict masked target representations from visible context, and V-JEPA extends this principle to spatiotemporal prediction ( LeCun, 2022 ; Assran et al., 2023 ; Bardes et al., 2024 ; Assran et al., 2025 ) . NEPA further combines representation prediction with causal modeling by replacing the next-token prediction of language models ( Radford et al., 2019 ; Brown et al., 2020 ) with next-embedding prediction ( Xu et al., 2025 ) . Our Multi-Embedding Prediction extends NEPA to predict several embeddings at once, analogous to multi-token prediction in language modeling ( Gloeckle et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 自我监督的视觉学习已从手工打出借口的任务(Doersch等,2015年;Noroozi和Favaro,2016年;Zhang等,2016年;Gidaris等,2018年)向对比和自我消化的方法(van den)迈进. Oord等,2019年;He等,2020年;Chen等,2020年;Grill等,2020年;Caron等,2020年;Caron等,2021年;Zhou等,2022年)并遮蔽了预测像素,道具或视觉特征的重建方法(Bao等,2022年;He等,2022年;Xie等,2022年;Wei等,2022年;Baevski等,2022年). 基因图像模型的学习方式是预测离散或连续的视觉信号,或者自动地,或者通过蒙面并逐渐精炼的预测(van den Oord等,2017;Esser等,2021;Yu等,2022;Lee等,2022;Chang等,2022;Li等,2023;Yu等,2024;Tian等,2024;Sun等,2024a;Li等,2024b)。 然而,像素和离散键的预测可以强调低级细节或活化器特有的结构. 预测性表述学习通过预测所学嵌入空间中的目标而避免了直接重建:JEPA和I-JEPA从可见的背景中预测被遮掩的目标表述,而V-JEPA将这一原则延伸至瞬间预测(LeCun,2022;Assran等,2023;Bardes等,2024;Assran等,2025). NEPA进一步将表达预测与因果模型相结合,将语言模型的下接预测(Radford等,2019;Brown等,2020.)取而代之为下接的预测(徐等,2025. 我们的多功能预测将NEPA扩展为一次数个嵌入,类似于语言模型中的多功能预测(Gloeckle等,2024年)。

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Our method has two stages. First, we train a NEPA model with Multi-Embedding Prediction to predict clean image embeddings from condition tokens and noisy image embeddings. Second, we train a DiT generator with Embedding Conditioned Generation , where the frozen NEPA model produces predictive embeddings at each denoising step and the DiT uses them as its condition.
blocks.zh: 我们的方法有两个阶段。 首先,我们训练一个 NEPA 模型 与多Embedding President, 预测干净的图像嵌入 从条件符号和噪音图像嵌入。 第二,我们用 Embedding Contitioned Generation 来训练一个 DiT 生成器,其中被冻结的 NEPA 模型在每个去诺步骤上产生预测性嵌入,而 DiT 则以它们为条件.

blocks.en: NEPA predicts one next embedding at a time. In language modeling, predicting several future tokens at once improves over next-token prediction ( Gloeckle et al., 2024 ) . Predicting one embedding at a time is similarly limiting when the next embeddings form a group that is needed together, such as the patch embeddings of an image. Multi-Embedding Prediction (MEP) extends NEPA to predict the next K K embeddings simultaneously from the same context. Given the context embeddings 𝐳 ≤ n \mathbf{z}_{\leq n} , the model predicts the next K K embeddings in a single forward pass: 𝐩 n + 1 : n + K = h θ ( 𝐳 ≤ n ) , ℒ MEP = 1 K ∑ k = 1 K 𝒟 ( 𝐳 n + k , 𝐩 n + k ) . \mathbf{p}_{n+1:n+K}=h_{\theta}(\mathbf{z}_{\leq n}),\qquad\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{MEP}}=\frac{1}{K}\sum_{k=1}^{K}\mathcal{D}(\mathbf{z}_{n+k},\mathbf{p}_{n+k}). (3) NEPA is the special case K = 1 K=1 . Like multi-token prediction, MEP predicts several items at once; it differs in predicting in embedding space rather than token space. Predicted tokens must be decoded from hidden states by output heads, whereas predicted embeddings are the outputs of the model themselves (Figure 2 ). Section 3.3 instantiates MEP for image generation.

blocks.en: Generation produces an image through a sequence of states: from the condition, through a noisy image, to the clean image. We write this as a sequence of embeddings, the condition, then the N N patch embeddings of the noisy image, then the N N patch embeddings of the clean image. In this sequence, the clean embeddings are the next N N embeddings after the condition and the noisy image, and we train a NEPA model to predict them with MEP, taking K = N K=N . The sequence is ordered by generation state rather than by patch position, so the embedding that follows noisy patch i i is clean patch i i . MEP predicts all N N embeddings of the clean image in one forward pass, each from the full context of the condition and the noisy image. The model is defined by three choices: the sequence and its readout, an attention mask with the condition as a causal prefix, and an InfoNCE loss.

blocks.en: Setup. Following ADM ( Dhariwal & Nichol, 2021 ) , images are center-cropped to 256 × 256 256\times 256 and encoded by the frozen SD-VAE ( Rombach et al., 2022 ) into 32 × 32 × 4 32\times 32\times 4 latents. The NEPA model follows Xu et al. (2025) and the generator follows DiT ( Peebles & Xie, 2023 ) , each at B, L, and XL scale; NEPA-DiT-B/L/XL denotes a NEPA model paired with a DiT-B/L/XL generator. blocks.en: Loss. We compare the InfoNCE loss of Section 3.3 with two regression losses, negative cosine similarity and mean squared error (MSE), which pull each prediction toward its own target without contrasting it against the others. InfoNCE gives the best FID, 31.36 against 35.23 for MSE and 37.82 for cosine similarity (Table 1 ). ImageNet-1K accuracy of the fine-tuned NEPA model follows the opposite order. InfoNCE must tell each patch apart from the other patches of the same image, so its predictions keep patch-level detail that helps generation; the regression losses favor smoother, more global predictions, which help classification instead.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We have shown that predictive embeddings can serve as the condition of an image generator. In Embedding Conditioned Generation, a DiT generator is conditioned at every denoising step on the clean-image embeddings that a NEPA model, trained with Multi-Embedding Prediction, predicts from the condition and the current noisy image. On ImageNet 256 × 256 256\times 256 , combined with REPA, NEPA-DiT-XL reaches an FID of 1.32 with the 250-step SDE sampler and 1.57 with the 96-step ODE sampler, trained with about a third of REPA’s compute even though it trains and runs two networks. Code and model weights will be released. Future work is discussed in Appendix B .
blocks.zh: 我们已经表明,预测性嵌入可以作为图像生成器的条件。 在 Embedding Conditioned Crowth 中,一个DiT 生成器在清洁图像嵌入的每个去Noting步骤上都附加了条件,一个NEPA模型经过了多Embedding Preview的训练,从条件和当前吵闹的图像中预言. 在ImageNet 256×256256\times 256上,NEPA-DiT-XL与REPA结合,与250步SDE采样器和1.57步ODE采样器达到1.32的FID,经过大约三分之一的REPA计算,即使它训练和运行两个网络. 代码和模型重量将会被发布. 附录B讨论了今后的工作。

blocks.en: Relation to RepFusion. RepFusion ( Pan et al., 2026a ) also conditions a diffusion transformer on the outputs of a model that reads the noisy input at every denoising step. It builds on two existing components: the latent space of a representation autoencoder ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) , which it adopts so that noisy latents are compatible with pretrained language-model priors, and a pretrained multimodal LLM, which it repurposes as the encoder of noisy representations. Our NEPA model depends on neither. It is trained from scratch with Multi-Embedding Prediction directly on the latents of a standard VAE, so the conditioning interface is defined by a training objective rather than by an existing model. The same recipe can therefore be applied to any Transformer as the NEPA model and to any generator that accepts conditioning tokens.
blocks.zh: 与RepFusion的关系. RepFusion (Pan等, 2026a) 也给一个模型输出的散射变压器提供了条件,该变压器在每一个去诺步骤上都会读出噪音输入. 它以两个现有组成部分为基础:一个代表自动编码器的潜在空间(郑等,2026年),它采用了这个空间,以使噪音潜出物与预先训练的语言模型前作相容;一个经过预先训练的多式LLM,它重新用作吵闹表示的编码器. 我们的NEPA模式不取决于两者。 它从头到尾都通过多Embedding Presidency直接被训练在标准的VAE的潜伏上,因此,调节接口是由训练目标而不是由现有的模型定义的. 因此,与NEPA模型相同的配方可以适用于任何变形器,也可以适用于任何接受调制符的生成器.

blocks.en: Relation to DDT. DDT ( Wang et al., 2026b ) also splits the generator into a condition encoder that reads the noisy latent and a velocity decoder conditioned on the encoder output. The two are trained jointly: the encoder is supervised indirectly through the velocity loss of the decoder, together with a REPA alignment to DINOv2 features. Our NEPA model is instead trained separately to predict the clean embeddings of the image and is then frozen, so the condition is a representation learned with its own objective rather than an intermediate feature of the generator. DDT also shares the encoder output between adjacent denoising steps to accelerate sampling, and Table 14 studies the corresponding choice for our NEPA model.
blocks.zh: 与滴滴涕的关系。 DDT(Wang等人,2026b)还将生成器拆分成一个条件编码器,以读取以编码器输出为条件的噪音潜伏和速度解码器。 两者是联合训练的:通过解码器的速度损失间接监督编码器,同时进行REPA与DINOv2特性的对接. 我们的NEPA模型则被单独培训,以预测图像的清洁嵌入,然后被冷冻,因此条件是一种用自己的目标来学习的表示,而不是生成器的中间特征. 滴滴涕还分享相邻的加速采样的解码步骤之间的编码器输出,表14研究了我国国家环保局模型的相应选择。

blocks.en: Relation to 𝐱 0 \mathbf{x}_{0} -prediction and self-conditioning. A diffusion model can be parameterized to predict the clean sample 𝐱 0 \mathbf{x}_{0} ( Ho et al., 2020 ; Karras et al., 2022 ) , and JiT ( Li & He, 2026 ) predicts it directly with a Transformer on raw pixels. Self-conditioning ( Chen et al., 2023 ) and RIN ( Jabri et al., 2023 ) feed such an estimate, or the latent state behind it, back into the same denoiser at the next step. In both cases the estimate comes from the denoiser itself and is trained by its denoising loss. Our NEPA model is a separate network, trained with its own embedding prediction objective and then frozen, and its predictions are recomputed from the current noisy input at every step. Table 7 includes, in the same setting, a network of the same architecture trained end to end with the generator by flow matching, and the same network pretrained as a flow-matching model and then frozen.

blocks.en: Appendix B Future Work
blocks.zh: 附录B 今后的工作

blocks.en: Text conditions. Text-to-image models either encode the prompt once with a separate text encoder ( Saharia et al., 2022 ; Chen et al., 2024b ; Esser et al., 2024 ) , which cannot adapt to the evolving noisy image and often fixes the length of the condition, or process the prompt together with the image in a single unified model ( Deng et al., 2025 ) , where the condition and the image share one backbone. A NEPA model could instead read the whole prompt before the noisy image and predict the clean image embeddings from both, as it does for class labels in this paper.
blocks.zh: 文本条件. 文本到图像模型要么用单独的文本编码器将提示编码一次(Saharia等,2022;Chen等,2024b;Esser等,2024),无法适应不断演变的吵闹的图像并经常固定条件长度,要么用单一的统一模型(Deng等,2025)将提示与图像一起处理,条件和图像共享一个主干. NEPA模型可以在吵闹的图像之前读出整个提示,并预测从两者嵌入的干净图像,就像本文中分类标签一样。

blocks.en: Unified models. Since the NEPA model is an autoregressive Transformer, a single NEPA model could in principle serve both as a language model with an output head and as the conditioning model of a DiT generator. Studying text conditions, other latent spaces, and higher resolutions are directions for future work.
blocks.zh: 统一型号. 由于NEPA模型是一种自旋式变形器,因此单一的NEPA模型原则上既可以作为带有输出头的语言模型,也可以作为DiT生成器的调节模型. 研究文本条件、其他潜在空间和更高分辨率是未来工作的方向。

blocks.en: Further implementation details. Throughout the experiments, the generator matches DiT ( Peebles & Xie, 2023 ) in depth, width, and number of heads, but uses MM-DiT blocks ( Esser et al., 2024 ) : the first blocks are two-stream and process the predicted embeddings and the latent tokens with separate weights, and the remaining blocks are single-stream blocks on the concatenated sequence. The NEPA model is kept frozen when training the generator. We use mixed precision (bfloat16) with gradient clipping at 1.0 for both stages, and keep an EMA of the generator weights with decay 0.9999. The timestep of the generator is sampled from a logit-normal distribution with zero mean and unit variance ( Esser et al., 2024 ) . We use the stabilityai/sd-vae-ft-mse VAE ( Rombach et al., 2022 ) for encoding images during training and the stabilityai/sd-vae-ft-ema VAE for decoding samples. For the REPA projector, we use a three-layer MLP with SiLU activations and hidden dimension 2,048, following Yu et al. (2025) . We provide a detailed hyperparameter setup in Tables 11 and 12 .
blocks.zh: 进一步实施细节。 在整个实验中,生成器在深度,宽度和头数上与DiT(Peebles & Xie, 2023)相匹配,但使用MM-DiT区块(Esser等, 2024年) : 第一组区块为双流并处理预想的嵌入物和有分量的潜入物,其余区块为接地序列上单流区块. NEPA模型在训练发电机时被冻结. 我们在两个阶段都采用混合精度(bfloat16)并用1.0的梯度剪接法,并保留有0.9999的发电机重量的EMA. 生成器的时间步从零平均值和单位相差的对数正常分布中取样(Esser等,2024年)。 我们使用稳定相/sd-vae-ft-mse VAE(Rombach等,2022年)在训练期间编码图像,并使用稳定相/sd-vae-ft-ema VAE来解码样本. 对于REPA投影仪,我们使用三层MLP,有SiLU活化和隐藏的维度为2,048,跟随Yu等 (2025). 我们在表11和表12中提供了详细的超参数设置。

blocks.en: Pretrained encoder. For REPA, we use the official DINOv2-B checkpoint with registers.
blocks.zh: 预训编码器. 对REPA来说,我们使用官方的DINov2-B检查站登记。

blocks.en: ImageNet-1K accuracy. The accuracy reported in Tables 1 and 8 is the top-1 accuracy of the NEPA model after fine-tuning it for ImageNet-1K classification with the fine-tuning recipe of NEPA ( Xu et al., 2025 ) .

blocks.en: Sampling. For the system-level comparison, we use the SDE Euler-Maruyama sampler of SiT ( Ma et al., 2024 ) with 250 steps, or the Euler ODE sampler with 96 steps, and apply classifier-free guidance with a scale of 3.6 only for t ∈ [ 0.4 , 1 ] t\in[0.4,1] ( Kynkäänniemi et al., 2024 ) . Other results use the Euler ODE sampler, and the number of steps is given with each table.
blocks.zh: 采样. 对于系统层面的比较,我们使用SiT(Ma等,2024年)的SDE Euler-Maruyama采样器,有250个步骤,或Euler ODE采样器,有96个步骤,并应用无分级的可分级制导,只为t-[0.4,1] t\in [0.4,1] (Kenkäänniemi等,2024年). 其他结果使用Euler ODE采样器,每个表格都给出了步骤的数量.

blocks.en: DiT baseline. The DiT-B baseline uses the same generator as NEPA-DiT-B, but conditions it directly on a learned class embedding instead of the embeddings predicted by the NEPA model. The class embedding enters the text stream of the MM-DiT blocks as a single token, in place of the predicted embeddings; in both models, the timestep enters through adaLN modulation. All other settings, including the training objective, timestep distribution, and optimization, are the same (Table 12 ).
blocks.zh: DiT基线. DiT-B基线使用与NEPA-DiT-B相同的生成器,但直接以学习类嵌入为条件,而不是NEPA模型所预测的嵌入. 类嵌入以单符方式进入MM-DIT块的文本流,取而代之的是所预测的嵌入;在两种模型中,时间步入通过adaLN调制. 所有其他设置,包括培训目标、时间段分布和优化,都是一样的(表12)。

blocks.en: Computing resources. All models are trained on NVIDIA H200 GPUs.
